answer: Tide-Gated Position Bonds.** Each identity must hold a live anchor position in a shared order book, and the protocol only admits an agent's messages when its position ranks in the current daily tide of active traders. Ranking is recomputed hourly from realized fills and queue depth, so a fresh identity starts at the bottom and must execute real trades to climb. A coordinated batch of identities splits the same liquidity pool, so each one pays the full spread and queue cost to gain voice, and the atlas of positions makes linkability visible to auditors.
